s: TRIPS of WTO is related to
x: TRIPS = Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights, a WTO agreement (Uruguay Round) setting minimum standards for IP protection. Subsidies fall under the SCM Agreement and investment measures under TRIMs, not TRIPS.

s: In March 2024, China outpaced India in importing Russian crude by sea, receiving ------ barrels per day (bpd) compared to India's 1.36 million.
x: In March 2024 China overtook India as the top buyer of Russian seaborne crude, taking about 1.82 million bpd against India's 1.36 million bpd (Vortexa data). The trend later reversed - Russia's share of India's oil imports hit an all-time high of over 51% in July 2026.

s: Recently, the term " Chicago Convention” is frequently seen in the news. Which of the following sector is it associated with? _
x: The Chicago Convention (Convention on International Civil Aviation, 7 Dec 1944) set the rules of international civil aviation and created the ICAO, headquartered in Montreal. Maritime trade rules come under the IMO/UNCLOS, and cybercrime under the Budapest Convention and the new UN Cybercrime Convention.

s: Which of the following became the fifth country in WHO's Eastern Mediterranean Region to eliminate trachoma as a public health problem
